data.title: Philippines voices concern over Myanmar airstrike deaths
data.description: MANILA - ⁠The ⁠Philippines has expressed concern over ​an airstrike in ‌Myanmar that caused about 50 civilian deaths, saying it stands ready as the Asean chair to facilitate discussions on how the bloc can best pursue peace in Myanmar.

data.title: Bangkok’s iconic buses to live on after surviving floods
data.description: Bangkok’s iconic cream-red buses will live on, with selected vehicles to be repurposed for emergency reserves after the ageing fleet proved its worth transporting passengers during the 2026 flood, says the director of the Bangkok Mass Transit Authority (BMTA).

data.title: Tigray rebels abandon regional capital in Ethiopia
data.description: ADDIS ABABA - Tigray rebels were abandoning their regional capital in northern Ethiopia on Saturday, a local journalist and residents told AFP, as pro-government forces advanced on the city.

data.title: New land formations linked to Anak Krakatau eruptions
data.description: JAKARTA - ⁠Anak ⁠Krakatau volcano in Indonesia expanded by ​81 acres (33 hectares) after recent eruptions produced lava flows, while ​satellite imagery detected two ‌new land formations nearby, the country’s Geology Agency said.

data.title: Ageing well: Staying mobile is key to long-term health
data.description: As people grow older, changes can occur throughout the body, including in the bones, muscles and joints. Joint degeneration and a gradual reduction in mobility can affect a person’s ability to carry out everyday activities.

data.title: Phuket delivery rider held for B3.7m in house thefts
data.description: PHUKET - A food delivery rider has been arrested on charges of breaking into two homes belonging to foreigners on this tourist island and making off with valuables, including cash and camera equipment, worth nearly 3.7 million baht.

data.description: Dzhamil Osmanov dismantled Ben Woolliss with three knockdowns in 84 seconds to earn a US$100,000 ONE Championship contract and join older brother Elbrus on the promotion’s main roster.

data.title: ONE Championship: Eersel, Jarvis reunite in hospital after ‘fight of the year’ thriller
data.description: Regian Eersel and George Jarvis both ended up in hospital after a brutal ONE Championship title fight, with the champion revealing a broken right arm and the English challenger saying he had fractured his eye socket.

data.title: North Korea fires missile after Seoul’s apology demand

data.title: Two Japanese rescued after being forced into border scam work
data.description: Thai police have rescued two Japanese men who said they were forced to travel to Thailand to work for a scam gang across the border in Myanmar, where they were made to defraud elderly people in Japan.
